title: Never let applied Supabase provider migration remain absent from original checked-in source lock
root_cause: The protected original PR #565? source migration 20261112144500 was applied by production Supabase, but original source migration-history.lock.json stayed on 828 rows instead of provider-confirmed 829. Unrelated SEO/website release therefore failed migration history checks when syncing with newest main.
impact: Original protected SEO release #5643 waits on main migration lock parity. Production migration is already applied; no need to replay DDL.
fix: Read provider original supabase_migrations ledger (829 rows, exact version/name) and append only matching source entry. Preserve first 828 lock rows, never reapply migration or create a scheduler.
prevention_rule: Every original migration deployment requires provider exact version/name readback and synchronized source lock before dependent PRs are merged or consumers given ACK.
owner: Original protected Supabase migration history writer / ONE BRAIN backend owner
